metadata.description: Change factors (future vs. historical) for five GCM models across four seasons.
metadata.temp_unit: K (delta change in mean daily max temperature)
metadata.et_unit: ratio (future / historical), median across watershed pixels
metadata.lai_unit: ratio (future / historical), median across watershed pixels
metadata.et_metric_rationale: Median used for ET: DJF distributions are right-skewed (a small number of high-flux pixels inflate the mean), so median better represents the typical change across the watershed.
metadata.et_min_hist_threshold: Change factors set to 1.0 where historical seasonal ET median < 0.20 cm/month (2.0 mm/month). All five models fall below this in DJF, so DJF ET CFs are 1.0 (no change applied — dormant-season baseline too small for a reliable ratio).
metadata.lai_metric_rationale: Median used for LAI: zero-value pixels (water, impervious surfaces) create a floor that shifts the mean; median is more robust to those non-vegetated outliers.
